# beGalileo

> > beGalileo offers AI-driven, personalized online math, English, and coding classes with live tutoring for K-12 students and schools, supporting multiple curricula including CBSE, IGCSE, IB, and US Common Core.

beGalileo is a comprehensive online learning platform specializing in interactive, personalized math education with live classes and 1:1 tutoring. The platform serves individual learners across all grade levels and institutional clients, supporting competitive math preparation, olympiad training, and multiple international curricula standards.

## Key Topics

- Personalized Learning
- Live Tutoring
- Interactive Classes
- Math Olympiad Preparation
- CBSE Curriculum
- IGCSE Exams
- IB Programs
- Competitive Math Prep
- Parent Tracking
- Self-Paced Learning
- Algebra & Geometry
- beGalileo Playbook
- Gifted Test Preparation
- Python & Coding
- Math Kangaroo
